messages:
incident-bot: P0 alert — smart-routing: routing policy schema change triggered at 2026-03-15T10:00Z. Error spike and request loops detected in eu-west and ap-south. Paging oncall: @sara. Affected: hosted API customers (some 5xx+ increased by 12x).

sara: on it. paging received. grabbing logs and policy diff. switching to incident channel.

mike: I'm shadowing — if this is schema-related we should assume rollout of config v2 hit prod. @anita can you confirm whether the new validator ran?

anita: looking. quick summary: yesterday we promoted routing-schema v2 which deprecated `fallback_target` in favor of `fallback_policy`. The migration path was supposed to auto-map strings, but the deploy omitted the mapper flag. As a result unspecified routes are now hitting the global `regional-fallback` policy instead of falling back to a single model. That created a cascading cross-region loop when capacity checks bounce requests.

ben: customers are reporting timeouts and higher token charges. @irene any customer P1s already open?

irene: yes — cust: NovaSearch (enterprise) opened a ticket at 09:57 UTC showing errors and increased latency. CS triage marked as P1. They're seeing repeated retries.

sara: mitigation plan: 1) disable smart-routing-policy v2 2) pin critical customers to model-variant `redwood/gptx-4-8k:2026-03-10` 3) rollback config rollout or force mapper. Who has permission to flip the toggle?

mike: I can flip the toggle. Oncall handoff: I'll take command until rollback completes, then hand back to the daytime rotation. @ops-rotations FYI.

# quick commands and findings

anita: logs show the policy engine started returning `route: regional-fallback` for otherwise-matched routes. Sample snippet from policy state:

```json
{
  "route_id": "svc-search-42",
  "match": {"region": "eu-west"},
  "policy_version": "v2",
  "fallback_policy": "regional-fallback",
  "previous_fallback_target": "redwood/gptx-4-8k"
}
```

anita: notice the `previous_fallback_target` was left in the old field but not honored; due to missing mapper we now default to `regional-fallback`. That policy triggers cross-region handoffs and sometimes immediate re-route back, creating loops.

mike: rolling the toggle now — command: `redwoodctl routing disable --policy v2 --reason "incident 1775000000"`

deploy-bot: Roll request acknowledged. Change owner: mike. Change id: CHG-2026-813. Initiating change; will update here when complete.

mike: disabled smart-routing-policy v2 (confirmed). Observability: error rate dropping for eu-west within 30s. Latency trend normalizing.

sara: pinning NovaSearch to stable model: `redwoodctl routes pin --customer nova-search --model redwood/gptx-4-8k:2026-03-10` — done. CS notified.

irene: NovaSearch confirms reduced errors at 10:06 UTC. They want a status update to their SOC. Drafting message.

anita: temporary mitigation accomplished. Next steps for full resolution: 1) rollback the v2 schema rollout in config-store (if we can't safely re-run mapper) 2) deploy hotfix to validator to emit warning when deprecated fields present 3) add unit + e2e test for mapping behavior 4) customer-facing RCA + changelog entry.

mike: kicking rollback of the rollout in config-store now: `config-store rollback --campaign routing-schema-v2 --to-tag routing-schema-v1`

deploy-bot: Rollback succeeded. Config commit reverted: commit ref abc123 -> rollback to def456.

sara: monitoring continues. error spike back to baseline at 10:09. marking incident contained.

ben: escalation notes: potential revenue impact for 3 customers; recommend crediting a week of overage for affected tenants. Filing follow-up with finance.

ops-rotations: mike — please hand off to next oncall at shift change. leave short runbook in the incident doc.

mike: handing off to @sara (day shift) at 10:20 UTC. I'll stay available for 30 min. Runbook note: how to revert smart-routing toggle, how to pin models, where to find policy diffs: /runbooks/routing-schema.

anita: post-incident actions I'll own: 1) hotfix validator to error on deprecated fields 2) add CI gating that runs mapper in staging with sample traffic 3) add console deprecation banner when UI shows `fallback_target`. ETA 3 days.

irene: communications: I will send customers an interim note confirming containment + next steps, and coordinate NovaSearch follow-up.

mike: postmortem owners: anita (tech lead), irene (customer comms), ben (billing impact). Target: draft PM within 72 hours.

sara: closing slack incident thread now, moving discussion to #incidents-postmortem and creating JIRA INC-1775000 with action items. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident P0 -> contained. Summary: routing-schema v2 rollout missed mapper flag, deprecated `fallback_target` not auto-mapped, defaulted to `regional-fallback` causing cross-region fallback loops and customer impact. Containment: disabled v2, pinned customers, rolled back config. Next steps: validator hotfix + CI + customer RCA.
